camel_example: aliyun wss ModifyInstanceProperties --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceType DurationPackage --version 2021-12-21 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the attributes of an instance
name: ModifyInstanceProperties

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.
This parameter is case-sensitive. Ensure correct spelling
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。
该参数区分大小写，请确保拼写正确
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The value of the attribute.

PackageUsedUpStrategy: [enum]
Postpaid (switches to the pay-as-you-go billing method)
Shutdown (hibernates or shuts down the instance)
Maintenance (stops the instance and enters O&M mode, and does not allow client connections)
parameters.help_zh:
属性的值（value）。

PackageUsedUpStrategy：[枚举]
Postpaid（进入按需付费阶段）
Shutdown（休眠/关机）
Maintenance（停机并进入运维模式，不允许客户端连接）
parameters.name: value

fields.help_en: The name of the instance attribute. For example, DisableRemainingNotify specifies whether to disable the remaining duration reminder for the client, and PackageUsedUpStrategy specifies the policy applied when the package duration is used up
fields.help_zh: 实例属性名称。例如，DisableRemainingNotify 表示是否关闭终端剩余时长提醒，PackageUsedUpStrategy 表示时长用尽策略
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the instance attribute. When Key is set to DisableRemainingNotify, only the string true or false is supported, and ResourceType must be set to DurationPackage. A value of true indicates that the remaining duration reminder for the client is disabled. A value of false indicates that the reminder is retained and triggered based on the original conditions. Administrator notifications continue to be triggered based on the original conditions. For other attributes, pass values based on their respective definitions
fields.help_zh: 实例属性值。当 Key 为 DisableRemainingNotify 时，仅支持字符串 true 或 false，且 ResourceType 必须为 DurationPackage。true 表示关闭终端剩余时长提醒；false 表示保留提醒，仍按原条件触发。管理员通知继续按原条件触发。其他属性按各自定义传值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of instance attributes to modify. You can modify multiple key-value pairs at a time. These pairs are merged with the original Key and Value request parameters. If an attribute with the same name has the same value, it is deduplicated. If the values are different, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的实例属性列表，支持一次修改多组 Key/Value，并与原 Key、Value 入参合并处理。同名属性值一致时去重，不一致时返回参数错误
parameters.name: properties
